title: The Social Network
review: A masterclass in pacing. It perfectly captures the chaotic energy of building a tech startup and the complex human dynamics behind it.

title: Moneyball
review: Changing the game with data. This movie shows exactly why quantitative analysis is a superpower in any industry.

title: The Founder
review: A ruthless look at scaling a business. It highlights the stark difference between having a great product and having a scalable system.

title: Steve Jobs
review: Brilliant dialogue. It focuses heavily on product launches and the uncompromising vision required to build a legacy.
